_help: Cover songs. sections = the tabs on the page (id = the part after # in the address, e.g. covers/#ghazals; label = tab name; intro and emptyText optional; playlistId = a YouTube playlist for that section: its videos are added automatically every day by the YouTube sync; hideVideoIds = playlist videos NOT to show). A tab with no videos and no playlist is hidden until it has some. A tab with 'href' instead of videos is a link to another page (e.g. Poetic Treasures). To add a tab: add a section here and, if wanted, a menu line in site.json (covers/#<id>). items = covers you add yourself. Fields: id (unique), section (one of the section ids), title (song name; if empty, the YouTube title collected by the daily sync is shown), year (optional number), date (optional YYYY-MM-DD), videoId, originalArtist (optional), credits (optional short line), description (optional), spotifyUrl, listenUrl, featured (true pins to top), source. Never add song lyrics.
intro: Cover versions, ghazals, devotional songs and unplugged sessions. Nihira's recitations are under Poetic Treasures.
